data.report: Sunday, November 22, 2026 10:45 AM – Gray skies and a steady southwest breeze set a wintry tone for Sunday, with temperatures ranging from the upper teens to the mid-20s. 19 lifts are open, conditions permitting. Expect consistent packed powder across the mountain, with smooth turns on groomed runs and firmer, wind-affected snow in more exposed areas. A few flurries are possible this evening before sunshine returns Monday. Woolly's Adventure Summit is open! Take advantage of fun winter activities and food & beverage options for a day of mountain fun beyond skiing and riding. You can also sign up for the Full Moon Snowshoe Tour , happening today from 6:15 PM to 8 PM at Tamarack Cross-Country Ski Center. It's a great way to enjoy a winter evening with family and friends! Conditions and Visibility: Cloudy skies and a steady southwest breeze will keep things feeling wintry today. Expect settled packed powder and fresh corduroy on groomed runs, with wind-packed snow in exposed areas. Flat light is likely under the cloud cover, so be sure to pack a low-light lens. Lift Status: 19 lifts are open, conditions permitting. Safety: Deep Snow & Early-Season Conditions. Last week's storm left us with plenty of deep snow , so ride with a partner, keep them in sight and give tree wells plenty of space. Be aware of early-season obstacles that may still be hidden beneath the new snow. While we're excited to have all this fresh snow, the mountain isn't quite riding like it does in peak season just yet. Stick to open, groomed trails and ride within your ability . Visit our Safety page for more tips. Our on-mountain emergency hotline is 760.934.0611 . Road Conditions: Always be prepared for winter mountain driving and watch for icy patches, especially in shaded areas. Check our Road Conditions page for the latest updates.

Monday, November 21, 2026 6:00 AM – Monday brings sunny skies and light winds, with temperatures starting in the teens before climbing into the low 30s. 19 lifts are expected to spin today, conditions permitting. Expect settled packed powder and fresh corduroy across groomed runs, with firm and fast conditions early before sunny slopes soften slightly through the afternoon. Exposed terrain up high will hold some wind-packed snow. For a smooth first carve, head down Saddle Bowl off Face Lift Express (3) while the corduroy is still crisp. Conditions and Visibility: Mostly sunny skies with a few passing clouds around midday, light winds and cool temperatures. Expect packed powder and groomed corduroy across the mountain, with firmer conditions early and a slight softening on sunny aspects through the afternoon. Exposed areas may hold wind-packed snow. Lift Status: 19 lifts are expected to spin today, conditions permitting. Safety: Be aware of early-season obstacles that may still be hidden beneath the snow. Conditions aren't quite like peak season just yet, so stick to open, groomed trails and ride within your ability level . Give other skiers and riders plenty of room, especially when passing on firm, fast groomers. There is no uphill skiing or skinning access anywhere on the resort . Visit our Safety page for more tips. Our on-mountain emergency hotline is 760.934.0611. Road Conditions: Always be prepared for winter mountain driving and watch for icy patches, especially in shaded areas. Check our Road Conditions page for the latest updates.
